customer: Hi, im moving to Virginia for a new job and want to sell my hybrid sedan before i go, but i think i still owe more on the loan then what your offer was. can i even sell it to you if im upside down on it? and how would i pay the diffrence, can i just put it on my credit card?
agent: Congratulations on the new job, and yes, you can still sell us your hybrid sedan even if your loan balance is higher than our offer, which is called negative equity. At your appointment, we'll compare our offer with your payoff letter, and you'll pay the difference then. We accept a cashier's check, a debit card or a personal check for that payment, but unfortunately we can't accept credit cards. You can find more details in our article "If you owe more than our offer."
